title.en: The prepositional case: where and about what

card: Use the prepositional after **в** and **на** for *location* (где?) and after **о/об** for *about*. Almost every noun simply ends in **-е**: **в Москве́**, **на столе́**, **о кни́ге**. Feminine **-ь** nouns and nouns in **-ия/-ие** take **-и**: **в Росси́и**, **о жи́зни**.

sections.body:
This is the only case that never appears without a preposition, which is where its name comes from. Its two everyday jobs are answering **где?** (*where?*) with **в** and **на**, and saying what you speak or think **about** with **о**.

It is usually the first case learners master, because the ending is so regular: in the singular it is nearly always **-е**.

head: Nominative
Prepositional
Examples
rows: **стол → на столе́**, **музе́й → в музе́е**, **шко́ла → в шко́ле**, **окно́ → на окне́**

sections.title: в or на?
sections.body:
Both mean *in/at/on*, and the choice is mostly about the place itself:

- **в** for enclosed spaces and most buildings, cities and countries: **в ко́мнате**, **в шко́ле**, **в Москве́**, **в Росси́и**.
- **на** for surfaces and open areas: **на столе́**, **на у́лице**, **на пло́щади**.
- **на** also for events and activities, and for a fixed list of places that must simply be learned: **на конце́рте**, **на рабо́те**, **на уро́ке**, **на по́чте**, **на вокза́ле**, **на ры́нке**, **на заво́де**, **на ро́дине**.

The partner prepositions for *from* follow the same split: **в → из**, **на → с** (**из шко́лы**, **с рабо́ты**).

sections.title: The stressed -у́: в лесу́, на мосту́
sections.body: About a hundred common masculine nouns take a stressed **-у́** after **в** and **на** when they mean location: **в лесу́**, **в саду́**, **на мосту́**, **в углу́**, **на берегу́**, **в году́**. After **о** they go back to the normal **-е**: **о ле́се**, **о са́де**. The dictionary marks these; the word pages show both.

English chooses between *in*, *at* and *on* by meaning; Russian chooses between **в** and **на** by habit as much as by meaning, so *at work* is **на рабо́те** but *at school* is **в шко́ле**. Learn the place together with its preposition: think of **на рабо́те** as one unit.

mistakes.why: *Living in* is a location (где?), so prepositional. **в Москву́** (accusative) means *to Moscow*.
